name: 1-Phosphatidyl-D-myo-inositol inositolphosphohydrolase

notes.r2171_previous_equation: m1393[C_cy] PI + 100 m32[C_cy] H2O = 100 m10[C_cy] H+ + m1994[C_cy] DAG + 100 m813[C_cy] inositol 1-phosphate, irreversible (charge -100)
notes.r2171_pi_plc_evidence: Written 1:1 as its own KEGG link R03332 (PI + H2O = Ins1P + DAG) and ModelSEED rxn06362; 2 H+ balance charge under the model charges. The 100x form is in no source found and is inherited from iYli21. As written it let an INO1-null strain grow without inositol and made Ins1P without phosphate uptake (model/reports/lipid_source_leak_check_20261028).
notes.r2171_pi_plc_limits: Gene YALI1D13510g = YALI0D10813g: KEGG K01771 (EC 4.6.1.13, an enzyme KEGG calls bacterial, product inositol 1,2-cyclic phosphate) and UniProt Q6C9J1 (unreviewed, score 1, PI-PLC X domain only); its real activity and product are unknown. Mass balance not checkable (PI and DAG are lumped).
notes.r2171_pi_plc_authorization: User authorized writing R2171 as PI + H2O = DAG + Ins1P + 2 H+ (Option A) on 2026-10-28.

evidence.claim: KEGG R03332, the model's kegg.reaction link for R2171, is 1-Phosphatidyl-D-myo-inositol + H2O <=> Inositol 1-phosphate + 1,2-Diacyl-sn-glycerol, 1:1:1:1.
ModelSEED rxn06362 and rxn39389 are the same 1:1 hydrolase (status OK); none of the 8 reactions named inositolphosphohydrolase has 100x coefficients.
EC 4.6.1.13 forms 1D-myo-inositol 1,2-cyclic phosphate (R03364); KEGG comments that the enzyme is bacterial and that animal activity is EC 3.1.4.11.
evidence.scope: Read via rest.kegg.jp; reason the product of the gene is uncertain.

evidence.claim: YALI0D10813g (= YALI1D13510g by the S2 locus map) is RefSeq 1-phosphatidylinositol phosphodiesterase, KO K01771 (EC 4.6.1.13), the only Y. lipolytica member of K01771.
Q6C9J1 (YALI0D10813p): unreviewed, annotation score 1, 305 aa, one phosphatidylinositol-specific phospholipase C X domain (SMART SM00148), no function text.
On 9d655c2b, with INO1 knocked out and no inositol uptake, growth equals WT and inositol / Ins1P demand reach 511-520 / 1000; closing R2171 gives 0.
evidence.scope: Observed in runs (Stage 1), Task A + PO1f and three other media.

reviewer: Claude Code session (Opus 5.5), 2026-10-28; decision by the user
